hazard: Under-forecast of bed demand acted upon
description: Displayed forecast is materially lower than what happens; escalation capacity, staffing or discharge support not arranged.
possible_causes: Model error; unseen event (outbreak, divert, strike); stale or missing data feed
clinical_effect: Delayed admission from ED; care in corridors; possible deterioration
existing_controls: Forecast labelled advisory; bed meetings continue as now
additional_controls_proposed: Show uncertainty range; show 'last updated' and feed health; alert when recent errors exceed a threshold; written fallback procedure

hazard: Over-forecast of bed demand acted upon
description: Displayed forecast is materially higher than what happens.
possible_causes: Model error; one-off spikes in training data
clinical_effect: Unnecessary cancellation of planned surgery; unnecessary cost
additional_controls_proposed: Require a second source before cancelling on forecast alone

description: Nightly file fails or is late; screen shows yesterday's forecast with no warning.
possible_causes: Extract failure at the trust; network; our pipeline
additional_controls_proposed: Timestamp and red banner when data is more than 30 hours old

description: User reads the range as guaranteed minimum and maximum.
clinical_effect: Over-confidence in best or worst case

hazard: Forecast used for a purpose it was not built for
description: Patient-level or ward-level decisions (who to discharge, which nurse to move) justified by a site-level forecast.
possible_causes: Pressure; forecast treated as a target
clinical_effect: Premature discharge; unsafe staffing on donor ward

hazard: Unit-level forecast unreliable for small units
description: Children's ward, critical care, maternity and neonatal forecasts have large relative error.
Beds open / closed entered manually and not updated.
Hosting or login failure at the time of the bed meeting.
Used in a hospital or country where it has not been validated.
